comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up on the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13114#issuecomment-5824961951) and the [author reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13114#issuecomment-5825678164), checked at `c6c7904d`.

| Earlier finding | Status at `c6c7904d` |
|---|---|
| Empty `catch` blocks also silence unrelated injection failures | Resolved |
| "Fixes #13011" claims a crash fix that is not established | Resolved in the PR description and test comment; still present in the message of commit `10dd18a9` (see below) |

**Verified:** The `try/catch` blocks are gone, and `injectProps()` now skips the `moduleName` and `settings` writes only when `commandCustom` is true. `commandCustom` and the loader that creates `CustomCommandModule` read the same `entry`, so in steady state the guard matches exactly the in-tree module that declares those properties read-only. No needed value is lost, because `CustomCommandModule` derives both from `entry` itself. An isolated offscreen Qt 6.11.2 harness ran the verbatim `ModuleSlot` and `CustomCommandModule` from each revision, with stubbed bar dependencies, through 12 phases: list startup, two list rebuilds, eight entry changes (seven of them type changes) on a persistent slot standing in for the center anchor, and a positive control.

| Read-only `TypeError` warnings | Base | `10dd18a9` (try/catch) | Head |
|---|---|---|---|
| Command slots, 11 scenario phases | Logged in 7 | None | None |
| Custom QML widget that declares `moduleName` read-only (outside the documented contract) | Logged | Silenced | Logged, as at base |
| Final `bar` / `moduleName` / `settings` on every item | (reference) | Differs on that widget only | Identical to base |

Uncaught positive controls logged both the direct and the `Qt.callLater` warning, so the silent rows were not a logging failure. `bar-test.sh` passes at head (89 ok). The new assertion is true at head and false against base and `10dd18a9`.

### Commit `10dd18a9` still says "Fixes #13011"

The PR description now uses `Refs #13011`, and the test comment says the TypeError "preceded" the crash. The first commit is still in the PR, though. Its message says "The assignment threw a TypeError during delegate incubation and quickshell segfaulted inside QQuickRepeater::regenerate" and ends with `Fixes #13011`. `quattro` is the default branch, and GitHub closes an issue named by a closing keyword in a commit message when that commit reaches the default branch.

**Impact:** A merge-commit or rebase merge would still auto-close #13011, which the updated description intends to leave open. A squash merge depends on the final squash message, which was not checked.

**Suggested change:** Reword or squash `10dd18a9` so that no commit message carries `Fixes #13011` or the causal claim, or squash-merge with a message that drops it.

**Related:** Open issue #7635 tracks exactly this read-only `moduleName` TypeError, and this PR does not reference it. Open PR #13086 makes the same change with an enclosing `if (!commandCustom) { ... }` block. Each PR's new `bar-test.sh` assertion rejects the other's form, and #13086's patch no longer applies on this head.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of head `c6c7904d`, base and `10dd18a9`, plus qtdeclarative v6.11.2 source. Isolated runs covered `bar-test.sh` and `bar-text-color-test.sh` at all three revisions, plus the offscreen QtQuick harness described above. Not tested: the full Quickshell shell and real-shell binding order, the compositor-dependent bar tests (skipped), the #13011 SIGSEGV (no reproducer), and an actual merge.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
